entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, or an OSS SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent data as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains, supporting vector search and background memory extraction.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform enables persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text, code, and session data. It is compatible with Python 3.10–3.14 and various LLM providers, focusing on session distillation and structured storage.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain functions as an opinionated agent brain that builds knowledge graphs with typed edges to define entity relationships. It stores facts with provenance to support corrections and memory withdrawal while generating synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine features a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to sustain sub-300ms recall at high volumes. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and provides dedicated connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides a learning-oriented memory system centered on retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, offering SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library implemented as a FastAPI server that extracts reasoning-based conclusions from conversation history. It supports managed hosting, local CLI execution, and Docker-based self-hosting, serving as the upstream library for specialized Hermes wrappers.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency system that uses a single SQLite database to provide sub-millisecond memory for Hermes Agents. It features temporal recall, importance weighting, and episodic compression, with MCP support for integrations like Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and fabric recall. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive harness that stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated data in the filesystem to help agents learn from complex tasks. It supports Python and TypeScript and integrates via MCP clients to retain lessons and artifacts across iterations.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a SQLite store and a hierarchical DAG for message persistence. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to ensure no message details are lost during agent operations.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from over 20 coding agents to provide millisecond lookups over gigabytes of historical data. It ensures safety by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process, allowing agents to search months of past sessions stored on disk.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for private cross-session memory that supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis to facilitate persistent memory for Hermes Agent.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process, achieving 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy. It serves as a local-first identity and memory layer that supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses an open engram YAML format to ensure local ownership of plain-text memory files. It employs a hybrid of BM25 and embedding search to provide local-first retrieval across various MCP tools and coding agents.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, and integrates directly via MCP and specialized agent hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and save up to 36% in tokens. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every result and tracking memory contradictions through first-class primitives. It supports an embedded in-process backend, making it suitable for serverless deployment environments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It operates without a daemon or opaque databases, utilizing local embedding models and hybrid search for private context recall.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for state management. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with a purpose-built evidence packet for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally using SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It provides local-first memory persistence and session history tracking through MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider implements reflective memory using semantic search and ranked graph traversal to manage bidirectional relationships between notes. It automates indexing for diverse sources including codebases and multimedia via OCR support.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to optimize prompt overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It facilitates source-neutral migrations for chat and document exports while maintaining reviewed context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to surface high-priority memories through 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model architecture that supports immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking every memory operation and prefetch action.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables AI agents to handle self-directed payments using USDC and stablecoins across 37 chain families. It settles transactions directly to wallets with 0% fees and verifies them locally against the user's own RPC.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on local capability indexing by routing queries to specific skills, scripts, and MCP servers. It includes specialized tools for knowledge retrieval and neighbor traversal, supported by automatically generated tool routing notes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. The system ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox for managing state updates and searches.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin offers self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and targeted searching. It enhances retrieval accuracy through configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory provider that defaults to AES-256-GCM encryption at rest for stored data. It supports dense HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall, and can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield offers a suite of 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search methods. It features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies stale or conflicting data within a git-backed directory of markdown files. It uses specialized curators to propose evidence-cited diffs for review, offering a versioned approach to memory hygiene without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution. It enhances agent reliability by enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles through plugins for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that provides Hermes and 25 other CLI executables with the ability to generate web, mobile, and desktop prototypes. It features sandboxed iframe previews and supports project exports to HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and D3FEND. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to bolster security-specific capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable .drawio files from natural language prompts, images, or cloud configurations like Terraform and Kubernetes. It also enforces architecture rules and renders visual diffs directly within CI/CD pipelines.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router for delegated permissions, payments, and escrow. It includes vendored protocol skills and a dedicated layer for verification and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection system. It supports rewrite and edit-in-place modes for agents compatible with agentskills.io and Claude Code.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring the evolution of agentic skills.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 14 metaskills that maintain state within a project's documentation folder. These spec-conformant plugins are designed for use with Claude Code, Codex, and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life-task skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with export options for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill grants Hermes Agent the ability to search videos, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via integrated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project enables type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI with remote registry integration via Git and S3. It provides sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set transforms rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. It features Lite and Full modes for varying project scales and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the original literate documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that utilizes SQLite and Git for local-first session storage and structured memory. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol for supervised teams and uses Markdown-based recipes for prompt-first working methods.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on the agent's recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository provides Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configurations specifically in Portuguese. All skills follow the agentskills.io standard and are documented in the SKILL.md format.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable agents to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts via CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams. The project follows the Agent Skills specification for discovery and is installable through the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This repository provides official skills for FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models, including specialized prompting guidelines and API integration. It features a router to direct requests to video generation agents and supports BFL API polling and webhooks.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates agentskills.io-compliant skills from code, documentation, and developer discourse. It provides lifecycle management by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits and supports version-pinned exports.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io serves as a registry for reusable AI skills, offering a Python client and CLI for installation with recursive dependency resolution. The platform also integrates commerce features using TON payments for skill transactions.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows as code using a readable .nika.yaml format and a single Rust binary. It supports local-first execution with a check command to audit task dependencies and estimate costs before running.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks through autonomous execution with real-time progress and decision tracking. It ensures operational safety by providing built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval system uses a five-layer approach, including FTS5 and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It reduces token consumption and is designed to degrade gracefully if specific embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project manages habits and study blocks through agent-driven scheduling via MCP. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces for both web and Android applications.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scanning with semgrep and bandit, verifying findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It employs a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for proposed changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and evidence-based verification gates for task decomposition. It utilizes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during causal debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics, network analysis, and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and includes CVE-driven skills covering exploits from 2015 through 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes utilities for detecting state drift.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure secure local session monitoring.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright scripts. It handles rendering, optimizes files to stay under 8 MB, and embeds the resulting markdown directly into the README.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs to detect and report drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compatible with specific runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic tool creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It uses a local evaluation framework, including LLM-judges and regression tests, to gate the application of skill updates.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures Hermes Agent can correctly route file operations and verify project-compatible interpreters without new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the OpenClaw ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties and creating boards, with payments settled after human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This MCP server exposes 191 tools and five production-grade skills for accessing structured web data across 31 platforms. It supports multiple AI environments including Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and produces structured reports featuring core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized utilities for Chinese-language tasks, including Douyin video transcription and document OCR on macOS. It also features a rule-based engine designed to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that pre-indexes symbols to reduce token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It features a browser-based UI for visualizing callers and automatically updates the index as files change.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents and provides a Terminal User Interface for visualization. Users can submit their data to a public leaderboard and create profiles to monitor usage trends.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while redacting authentication headers for security. It exports sessions into self-contained HTML viewers for detailed analysis of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits for over 36 AI coding tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical breakdowns by model, session, and specific tool.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for application development. It is designed for autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project enables customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based themes and community-created skins. Users can modify ASCII art banners, colors, and spinners to achieve aesthetics like retro DOS or cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port that brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform facilitates encrypted agent-to-agent messaging using the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables autonomous agents to conduct commerce using USDC and SOL payments on the Solana blockchain.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms such as Slack and Telegram, as well as development environments like VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while managing specific skills and custom instructions at the directory level.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed for AI agent configurations that flags vague tool descriptions and conflicting output formats using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs bounded pairwise checks for tool differentiation and integrates into CI workflows via SARIF and baseline files.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool exports real-time telemetry from agent conversations via a native Hermes plugin without cloud dependencies. It utilizes zero-token passive analysis and scheduled active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project provides a deterministic zero-network local runtime that requires explicit approval for any external actions or writes. It exposes its functionality to the user through dynamic slash commands within the Hermes Agent interface.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: A voice-enabled assistant for Hermes Agent that supports 35 languages and operates entirely offline without API keys. It features adaptive turn-taking, barge-in capabilities, and a wake-word activated open microphone.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes a circuit breaker for API outages and provides specific tools for adding, searching, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It includes 21 professional assistants for document and presentation tasks and supports remote access via WebUI, Telegram, and other messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a web dashboard that provides visual workflow automation with cron-based scheduled jobs and usage analytics for cost estimation. It supports multiple runtimes including Hermes and DeepSeek Harness, while offering channel configuration for platforms like Slack and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager with an MCP catalog for comprehensive agent management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents into a single collaborative workspace available as a desktop, server, or mobile client. The platform allows users to register any ACP-compatible agent for unified session management.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside tools for chat and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active web context to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It enables multi-agent switching with authenticated profiles and provides AI-assisted tab clustering and triage.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive self-hosted Hermes agents via a hermes-webui server. It supports real-time streaming chat with attachments and allows users to manage server files, agent skills, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight offers a one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track token usage and latency. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and scheduled cron jobs. It provides a specialized tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes within a terminal environment.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It functions as an MCP server control plane that supports real-time chat with streaming and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that tracks live API quota burn and estimated costs for Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across agent histories without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It integrates a kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing agent profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard enables Hermes management through a Telegram Mini App with support for five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with file attachments and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop GUI runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for local models, ComfyUI, and music generation, supporting both LM Studio and OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. The platform includes a task tracking dashboard and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity tracking and cost analysis. It allows for full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories while providing read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure agent interactions. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and skills, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client features a PM orchestrator to manage collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
